::: {#def-flat-prior}
#### Flat prior (uniform prior)

A **flat prior**,
also called a **uniform prior**,
is a [prior](#def-prior) whose density is constant on the parameter space:
$\p(\param) \propto 1$ for $\param \in \Paramspace$.
:::

::: notes
A flat prior is a common choice of noninformative prior,
but "noninformative prior" is the broader idea:
other noninformative priors, such as Jeffreys priors, are not flat.
:::
